let loopId=0,lastAct=0,lastFmt='',stream=null,tm,busy=false,last='',lt=0,det=null,detKey='',zx=null,zxKey='',cand='',candN=0,candT=0,track=null,tOn=false;
const FMT=[['code_128','Code 128','CODE_128'],['code_39','Code 39','CODE_39'],['ean_13','EAN-13','EAN_13'],['ean_8','EAN-8','EAN_8'],['itf','ITF (2 z 5)','ITF'],['codabar','Codabar','CODABAR'],['qr_code','QR kód','QR_CODE'],['data_matrix','Data Matrix','DATA_MATRIX']];
const oneD=f=>f!=='qr_code'&&f!=='data_matrix';
const fmts=()=>{const a=FMT.map(f=>f[0]).filter(f=>(C.fm||[]).includes(f));return a.length?a:FMT.map(f=>f[0])};
// Oblast čtení: rámeček v okně kamery je zároveň výřez, ze kterého se opravdu čte
function aimDims(){const m=fmts().some(oneD)?C.ar:'full';return {m,ww:m==='full'?1:.95,hh:m==='narrow'?.4:m==='band'?.7:1}}
function roi(vd){const vw=vd.videoWidth,vh=vd.videoHeight,W=vd.clientWidth||vw,H=vd.clientHeight||vh,sc=Math.max(W/vw,H/vh),sw=W/sc,sh=H/sc,sx=(vw-sw)/2,sy=(vh-sh)/2,A=aimDims();
return {x:sx+sw*(1-A.ww)/2,y:sy+sh*(1-A.hh)/2,w:sw*A.ww,h:sh*A.hh}}
async function getDet(){
if(!('BarcodeDetector' in window))return null;
const f=fmts(),key=f.join();if(detKey===key)return det;
detKey=key;det=null;
try{let sup=f;try{const s=await BarcodeDetector.getSupportedFormats();sup=f.filter(x=>s.includes(x))}catch(e){}
if(sup.length)det=new BarcodeDetector({formats:sup})}catch(e){det=null}
return det}
function getZx(){
if(typeof ZXing==='undefined')return null;
const f=fmts(),key=f.join();if(zx&&zxKey===key)return zx;
const h=new Map();h.set(ZXing.DecodeHintType.TRY_HARDER,true);
h.set(ZXing.DecodeHintType.POSSIBLE_FORMATS,FMT.filter(x=>f.includes(x[0])).map(x=>ZXing.BarcodeFormat[x[2]]).filter(x=>x!==undefined));
const r=new ZXing.MultiFormatReader();r.setHints(h);zx={r,h};zxKey=key;return zx}
async function dec(src){
const dt=await getDet();
if(dt){try{const r=await dt.detect(src);if(r.length){
if(r.length>1){const cx=src.width/2,cy=src.height/2,dd=b=>{const q=b.boundingBox;return q?Math.hypot(q.x+q.width/2-cx,q.y+q.height/2-cy):0};r.sort((a,b)=>dd(a)-dd(b))}
lastFmt=r[0].format||'';return r[0].rawValue}}catch(e){}}
const z=getZx();
if(z){try{const res=z.r.decode(new ZXing.BinaryBitmap(new ZXing.HybridBinarizer(new ZXing.HTMLCanvasElementLuminanceSource(src))),z.h);try{lastFmt=String(ZXing.BarcodeFormat[res.getBarcodeFormat()]||'')}catch(e){}return res.getText()}catch(e){}}
return null}
function formatScanInput(el){const pos=el.selectionStart||0,digits=el.value.slice(0,pos).replace(/\D/g,'').length;el.value=fmt(el.value);let p=0,n=0;while(p<el.value.length&&n<digits){if(/\d/.test(el.value[p]))n++;p++}if(digits===0)p=0;try{el.setSelectionRange(p,p)}catch(e){}}
function accept(t){last=t;lt=Date.now();if(lastFmt){C.lf=String(lastFmt).toLowerCase();saveC()}const e=$('sn');if(e)e.value=fmt(t);doScan()}
async function decImg(src){for(const m of [2000,1400,900]){const k=Math.min(1,m/Math.max(src.width,src.height)),c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=Math.round(src.width*k);c.height=Math.round(src.height*k);c.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true}).drawImage(src,0,0,c.width,c.height);let t=null;try{t=await dec(c)}catch(e){}if(t&&(!C.val||/\d{6,}/.test(t)))return t}return null}
// Vyfotit štítek: když běží kamera, pořídí se snímek v plném rozlišení přímo v aplikaci (funguje i po přidání na plochu). Jinak se otevře fotoaparát telefonu.
async function snap(){
if(!stream){const i=$('ph');if(i)i.click();return}
const say=m=>{const e=$('cst');if(e)e.textContent=m};say('Fotím…');busy=true;let bmp=null;
try{if(window.ImageCapture&&track)bmp=await createImageBitmap(await new ImageCapture(track).takePhoto())}catch(e){}
try{if(!bmp)bmp=await createImageBitmap($('vid'))}catch(e){}
const t=bmp?await decImg(bmp):null;busy=false;if(!stream)return;
if(t)accept(t);else say('Kód se nepodařilo přečíst. Klepni na obraz pro zaostření a zkus to znovu.')}
async function focusTap(){
lastAct=Date.now();if(!track)return;
try{
const caps=track.getCapabilities?track.getCapabilities():{};
// Explicit standard constraint is more consistently honored by Android browsers;
// advanced constraints remain a fallback for implementations that expose only those.
if(caps.focusMode&&caps.focusMode.includes('single-shot')){
try{await track.applyConstraints({focusMode:'single-shot'})}catch(e){await track.applyConstraints({advanced:[{focusMode:'single-shot'}]})}
setTimeout(async()=>{try{if(!track)return;if(caps.focusMode.includes('continuous')){try{await track.applyConstraints({focusMode:'continuous'})}catch(e){await track.applyConstraints({advanced:[{focusMode:'continuous'}]})}}}catch(e){}},900);
}else if(caps.focusMode&&caps.focusMode.includes('continuous')){
try{await track.applyConstraints({focusMode:'continuous'})}catch(e){await track.applyConstraints({advanced:[{focusMode:'continuous'}]})}
}
}catch(e){}
}
function setZoom(x){lastAct=Date.now();C.zoom=+x;saveC();try{track&&track.applyConstraints({advanced:[{zoom:+x}]})}catch(e){}}
const fmtName=x=>{const f=FMT.find(a=>a[0]===x);return f?f[1]:x};
function onlyFmt(){if(FMT.some(a=>a[0]===C.lf)){C.fm=[C.lf];saveC();render();toast('Zapnutý jen typ: '+fmtName(C.lf))}else toast('Nejdřív naskenuj nějaký kód, aby se zjistil jeho typ')}
let wl=null,wp=false;
async function wake(){if(!C.wake||wl||wp||!('wakeLock' in navigator))return;wp=true;try{const l=await navigator.wakeLock.request('screen');wl=l;l.addEventListener('release',()=>{if(wl===l)wl=null})}catch(e){}wp=false}
function unwake(){const l=wl;wl=null;try{l&&l.release()}catch(e){}}
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='visible'&&stream)wake()});
async function openCam(){
const base={width:{ideal:1920},height:{ideal:1080},frameRate:{ideal:30,max:30}};
const get=c=>navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({video:Object.assign({},base,c),audio:false});
const auto=()=>get({facingMode:{ideal:'environment'}});
if(!C.deviceId)return {s:await auto()};
try{return {s:await get({deviceId:{exact:C.deviceId}})}}catch(e){}
// Při neplatném ID nejprve zkusíme najít kameru podle názvu bez otevření dalšího video streamu.
try{
const ds=(await navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices()).filter(d=>d.kind==='videoinput');
const m=C.deviceLabel&&ds.find(d=>d.label===C.deviceLabel);
if(m){const s=await get({deviceId:{exact:m.deviceId}});C.deviceId=m.deviceId;saveC();return {s}}
}catch(e){}
// Jediný fallback stream; žádná dočasná kamera před ním.
return {s:await auto(),fb:true};
}
async function camOn(){camOff();try{
await getDet();
{const o=await openCam();stream=o.s;if(o.fb)toast('Vybraná kamera není dostupná, tentokrát použita automatická volba')}
track=stream.getVideoTracks()[0];wake();
try{
const caps=track.getCapabilities?track.getCapabilities():{};
if(caps.focusMode&&caps.focusMode.includes('continuous')){
try{await track.applyConstraints({focusMode:'continuous'})}catch(e){await track.applyConstraints({advanced:[{focusMode:'continuous'}]})}
}
if(caps.exposureMode&&caps.exposureMode.includes('continuous')){
try{await track.applyConstraints({exposureMode:'continuous'})}catch(e){}
}
}catch(e){}
const vd=$('vid');vd.srcObject=stream;await vd.play();await frameReady(vd,1500);if(!stream)return;$('cw').style.display='block';$('cam').style.display='none';
try{const cp=track.getCapabilities?track.getCapabilities():{};if(cp.torch&&$('tb'))$('tb').style.display='block';if(cp.zoom&&$('zm')){const z=$('zm');z.min=cp.zoom.min;z.max=Math.min(cp.zoom.max,5);z.step=cp.zoom.step||.1;z.value=Math.min(Math.max(C.zoom||1,cp.zoom.min),z.max);z.style.display='block';setZoom(z.value)}}catch(e){}
const c=document.createElement('canvas'),x=c.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true}),need=C.cf||1,say=m=>{const e=$('cst');if(e)e.textContent=m};
cand='';candN=0;say('Hledám kód…');
const step=async()=>{if(busy||!stream||!vd.videoWidth)return;busy=true;
const R=roi(vd),s=Math.min(1,1600/R.w);c.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(R.w*s));c.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(R.h*s));
x.drawImage(vd,R.x,R.y,R.w,R.h,0,0,c.width,c.height);
let t=null;try{t=await dec(c)}catch(e){}
busy=false;if(!stream)return;
const now=Date.now();
if(t){lastAct=Date.now();
if(C.val&&!/\d{6,}/.test(t)){say('Přečteno „'+String(t).slice(0,30)+'“, nevypadá jako majetkové číslo.');return}
if(t===cand)candN++;else{cand=t;candN=1}
candT=now;
const kn=findIds(String(t)).all.length>0,nd=kn?(need>=3?2:1):Math.max(need,2);
if(candN>=nd){if(!(t===last&&now-lt<2500)){cand='';candN=0;accept(t)}}
else say('Potvrzuji čtení '+candN+'/'+nd+'…')
}else if(now-candT>1000){cand='';candN=0;say('Hledám kód…')}
};
// Smyčka místo setInterval: při skrytém displeji nečte, po 4 s bez čtení zpomalí, po 2 minutách bez čtení kameru pozastaví
const my=++loopId;lastAct=Date.now();
const loop=async()=>{if(my!==loopId||!stream)return;
if(document.visibilityState==='visible'){try{await step()}catch(e){busy=false}}
if(my!==loopId||!stream)return;
const idle=Date.now()-lastAct;
if(idle>120000){pauseCam();return}
tm=setTimeout(loop,idle>4000?600:300)};
loop()
}catch(e){const cb=$('cam'),cw=$('cw'),st=$('cst'),msg=cameraErrorText(e);if(cw)cw.style.display='none';if(cb)cb.style.display='block';if(st)st.textContent=msg;toast('Kameru se nepodařilo spustit. Zobrazili jsme doporučení u skeneru.')}}
async function torch(){try{tOn=!tOn;await track.applyConstraints({advanced:[{torch:tOn}]})}catch(e){tOn=false;toast('Svítilnu se nepodařilo zapnout')}}
function pauseCam(){camOff();const cb=$('cam'),cw=$('cw'),st=$('cst'),zm=$('zm'),tb=$('tb');if(cw)cw.style.display='none';if(zm)zm.style.display='none';if(tb)tb.style.display='none';if(cb)cb.style.display='block';if(st)st.textContent='Kamera se po 2 minutách bez čtení pozastavila, aby šetřila baterii. // Ochrana proti nechtěnému zavření stránky / gestu zpět při rozpracované inventuře
// Vlastní potvrzovací okno (místo systémového confirm), barvy se řídí zvolenou barvou aplikace
function askQ(msg,ok,cancel){return new Promise(res=>{const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='scrim';el.style.alignItems='center';el.style.zIndex=40;
el.innerHTML='<div class="sheet" role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true" style="max-width:420px;width:calc(100% - 32px);border-radius:12px"><h2></h2><p class="mut"></p><div class="two"><button class="btn" data-r="0"></button><button class="btn pri" data-r="1"></button></div></div>';
const b=el.querySelectorAll('button');{const p=String(msg).split('\n\n');el.querySelector('h2').textContent=p[0];const q=el.querySelector('p');if(p.length>1)q.textContent=p.slice(1).join(' ');else q.remove()}b[0].textContent=cancel||'Zrušit';b[1].textContent=ok||'OK';
const done=r=>{el.remove();res(r)};b[0].onclick=()=>done(false);b[1].onclick=()=>done(true);el.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===el)done(false)});
document.body.appendChild(el);b[1].focus()})}
let quitting=false;
async function quitApp(){
const u=D.length?unsaved():0,bk=!!C.bkQuit&&u>0;
if(!await askQ('Ukončit aplikaci?'+(bk?'\n\nPřed ukončením se stáhne záloha ('+u+' nezálohovaných položek).':''),'Ukončit','Zrušit'))return;
quitting=true;try{camOff()}catch(e){}
if(bk){try{await backup(true)}catch(e){}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900))}
save();saveC();
try{if(hasNat('closeApp')){Android.closeApp();return}}catch(e){}
try{window.close()}catch(e){}
setTimeout(()=>{quitting=false;toast(/iphone|ipad|ipod/i.test(navigator.userAgent)?'Aplikaci zavřeš přejetím od spodní hrany displeje nahoru':'Aplikaci zavřeš přepnutím aplikací a odsunutím této karty')},400)}
// ===== Výběrová pole v nastavení: vlastní seznam s barvou vybrané volby a posunem dlouhého textu =====
function selText(sel){const o=sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];return o?o.text:''}
function measureMq(){document.querySelectorAll('#app .cs-tx').forEach(tx=>{const t=tx.parentElement;tx.classList.remove('mq');tx.style.removeProperty('--d');
const over=tx.scrollWidth-t.clientWidth;if(over>2){tx.style.setProperty('--d',(-over)+'px');tx.style.animationDuration=Math.max(5,over/20+3)+'s';tx.classList.add('mq')}})}
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(v.tab==='set')measureMq()});
function enhSel(){
document.querySelectorAll('#app select.in').forEach(sel=>{
if(sel.dataset.enh)return;sel.dataset.enh='1';sel.style.display='none';
const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='in csel';b.setAttribute('aria-haspopup','listbox');
b.innerHTML='<span class="cs-t"><span class="cs-tx"></span></span><span class="cs-ar" aria-hidden="true">▾</span>';
const tx=b.querySelector('.cs-tx'),sync=()=>{const t=selText(sel);tx.textContent=t;b.title=t;b.setAttribute('aria-label',(lblOf(sel)?lblOf(sel)+': ':'')+t)};
b.sync=sync;sync();b.onclick=()=>openSel(sel,b);sel.after(b)});
requestAnimationFrame(measureMq)}
function lblOf(sel){const l=sel.id?document.querySelector('label[for="'+sel.id+'"]'):null;return l?l.textContent.trim():''}
function openSel(sel,btn){
const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='scrim csp';el.style.alignItems='center';el.style.zIndex=45;
const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='sheet';box.setAttribute('role','listbox');
const ttl=lblOf(sel);if(ttl){const h=document.createElement('div');h.className='cst';h.textContent=ttl;box.appendChild(h)}
let cur=null;
[...sel.options].forEach(o=>{const r=document.createElement('button');r.type='button';r.className='copt';r.setAttribute('role','option');
const on=o.value===sel.value;r.setAttribute('aria-selected',on?'true':'false');
r.innerHTML='<span class="cdot" aria-hidden="true"></span><span></span>';r.lastChild.textContent=o.text;if(on)cur=r;
r.onclick=()=>{el.remove();if(o.value!==sel.value){sel.value=o.value;sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}))}if(btn.sync){btn.sync();measureMq()}};
box.appendChild(r)});
el.appendChild(box);el.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===el)el.remove()});
el.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')el.remove()});
document.body.appendChild(el);if(cur){cur.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});cur.focus()}}
// ===== Tlačítko Zpět vždy vrací o krok a aplikaci nezavře =====
function backStep(){
if(shoot){shoot.close(null);return}
const dlg=document.querySelector('body > .scrim');
if(dlg){if(dlg.classList.contains('csp')){dlg.remove();return}const b=dlg.querySelector('button');if(b)b.click();return}
if(v.nf){nfCancel();return}
if(v.hist||v.it||v.sc||v.rs){closeS();return}
if(v.tab==='home'&&v.loc){go(null);return}
if(TST.length){const t=TST.pop();NB=true;try{t==='sum'?tabSum():t==='set'?tabSet():tabHome()}finally{NB=false}return}
toast('Zpět už není kam. Aplikaci ukončíš tlačítkem vypnutí vpravo dole.')}
try{history.replaceState({inv:'base'},'');history.pushState({inv:'app'},'')}catch(e){}
window.addEventListener('popstate',e=>{if(e.state&&e.state.inv==='app')return;backStep();try{history.pushState({inv:'app'},'')}catch(x){}});
// ===== Přejetí prstem střídá jen záložky Inventura a Souhrn (nekonečná smyčka) =====
(function(){let sx=0,sy=0,st=0,ok=false;
const blocked=el=>{for(let n=el;n&&n!==document.body;n=n.parentElement){const t=n.tagName,c=n.classList;
if(t==='INPUT'||t==='TEXTAREA'||t==='SELECT'||t==='VIDEO'||(c&&(c.contains('cw')||c.contains('rg'))))return true;
if(n.scrollWidth>n.clientWidth+4){const o=getComputedStyle(n).overflowX;if(o==='auto'||o==='scroll')return true}}return false};
document.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{ok=false;if(e.touches.length!==1)return;
if(v.it||v.sc||v.hist||v.rs||v.nf||(v.tab!=='home'&&v.tab!=='sum')||document.querySelector('body > .scrim'))return;
if(blocked(e.target))return;const t=e.touches[0];sx=t.clientX;sy=t.clientY;st=Date.now();ok=true},{passive:true});
document.addEventListener('touchend',e=>{if(!ok)return;ok=false;const t=e.changedTouches[0],dx=t.clientX-sx,dy=t.clientY-sy;
if(Date.now()-st>800||Math.abs(dx)<Math.max(70,innerWidth*.2)||Math.abs(dy)>Math.abs(dx)*.5)return;
if(String(getSelection()).length)return;
if(v.tab==='home')tabSum();else tabHome()},{passive:true});
document.addEventListener('touchcancel',()=>{ok=false},{passive:true})})();
window.addEventListener('beforeunload', e => {
if(quitting)return;
if(unsaved() > 0){
e.preventDefault();
e.returnValue = '';
}
});
tagAuth();render();try{navigator.storage&&navigator.storage.persist&&navigator.storage.persist()}catch(e){}
idbGet('file').then(x=>{if(x&&x.buf&&!D.length)load(x.buf,x.name)});
if('serviceWorker' in navigator)navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js',{updateViaCache:'none'}).catch(()=>{});
</script></body></html>
